source.title: Canada Year Book 1915, Table32: Area and Population of United Kingdom and British Possessions,1911
source.institution: Dominion Bureau of Statistics / official Statistics Canada historical facsimile
source.reproducedFrom: British Statistical Abstract—Self-Governing Dominions, Colonies, Possessions and Protectorates,1913

footnoteDefinitions.2: Excludes military and persons on ships in harbours.
footnoteDefinitions.4: New Territories and Wei-Hai-Wei leased in 1898; New Kowloon 13 sq miles and 13693 persons included in Hong Kong since 1904. Table combines Hong Kong/New Territories area 404 square miles but separates populations.
footnoteDefinitions.5: Australia population excludes full-blooded aborigines, estimated by this source at 100000 in 1911; historical discriminatory category retained only as source scope qualification.
footnoteDefinitions.6: Uganda area includes lakes and River Nile within protectorate territorial limits.
footnoteDefinitions.7: Partly estimated; census of natives unavailable.
footnoteDefinitions.9: Includes 567561 children whose sex is not stated.

reviewMethod: Lightweight visual review of ONLY32 proposed category rows against three cached official Table32 facsimiles100–102. All16 literal named rows,1911 heading and mandatory footnotes reviewed; single300dpi page101/crop resolves Canada total ambiguity. Existing names/whole-year framework scope checked, no source retrieval, percountry research, browser or production edit.

schemaContract.rows: One per32 original independent-review proposals; originalCandidateDigest and originalTableRowDigest preserve frozen extraction.
schemaContract.approvedMappedFields: Only approved fields integrate. Four population holds must not enter production.
schemaContract.area: Source-reported1911 tabulation with areaMeasurementDate null; never invented1911 survey measurement.
schemaContract.population: Table-reported1911 population at year precision, exact census date/method unspecified; exclusion and printed-number conflicts held.
schemaContract.priorContext: Observation1911 remains actual source year at1914 snapshot; do not retime or assert whole-year temporal validity.
